card.name: Digits right after a slash
card.fires_on: A digit token that comes right after a slash in a fraction or ratio, usually the first digit of the denominator. It shows up in formulas like W/2 and in patient counts like 23/247.

modes.label: Patient counts
modes.description: The first digit of the total after a slash in an incidence fraction such as n/N.
modes.example: Hypothyroidism occurred in 9% (23/<<2>>47) of patients receiving OPDIV
